shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat index.html && echo ----- && find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}' && echo ----- && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ----- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo -----; ls __agent_eval__ ; echo -----; head -c 6000 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && echo ----- && (npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40) && echo ----- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -30 && echo ----- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60

grep -n -i -A12 "page-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n '1,80p'; echo ----; npm view @diplodoc/transform version 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor@8.24.1 dependencies 2>/dev/null | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor@8.24.1 @diplodoc/transform@^4.28.2 --save 2>&1 | tail -15; echo ----; node -e 'for (const p of ["@gravity-ui/page-constructor","@diplodoc/transform","@gravity-ui/uikit"]) console.log(p, require("./node_modules/"+p+"/package.json").version)'; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs && cat INDEX.md; echo -----; ls blocks guides sub-blocks
cat blocks/Header.md; echo =====; cat blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; echo =====; cat blocks/Banner.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && ls styles; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "vite\|PageConstructorProvider\b" README.md | head -120; echo ----; ls build/docs/guides; grep -rn "lang" build/docs/INDEX.md | head; echo ----; ls build/esm | head -30; cat package.json | grep -n '"sass\|"exports\|"./styles'

sed -n 512,540p README.md; echo ----; grep -rn "PageConstructorProvider" build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5; echo ----; cat build/esm/context/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ----; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -i "^sass$\|vite-plugin-dynamic"
cat build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; grep -rln "import(" build/esm --include=*.js | head -5; echo ----; grep -n "export" build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30
cat build/esm/context/localeContext/*.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "theme" build/esm/context/theme/*.d.ts | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install -D sass@^1.63.6 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -3; node -e 'console.log("sass", require("./node_modules/sass/package.json").version)'
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles && wc -c styles.css && head -c 600 styles.css; echo; echo -----; grep -o "@import[^;]*;" styles.css | head; echo -----; cat styles.scss | head -20; grep -n "exports" -A3 ../package.json | head; grep -n '"./styles' ../package.json
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v -i "deprecat\|sass-lang\|@import\|╷\|╵\|│\|root stylesheet\|^$\|More info\|repetitive" | tail -40

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js; echo ----; grep -rln "from 'url'\|from \"url\"" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm | head; echo ----; ls node_modules/url 2>/dev/null && node -e 'console.log(require("./node_modules/url/package.json").version)'; npm view url version 2>/dev/null
npm install -D url@^0.11.4 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -2; node -e 'const p=require("./node_modules/url/package.json"); console.log(p.version, p.main, JSON.stringify(p.dependencies))'
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v -i "deprecat\|sass-lang\|@import\|╷\|╵\|│\|root stylesheet\|^$\|More info\|repetitive" | tail -30; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
rm -rf dist && git diff -- package.json vite.config.ts && git status --short
